note: ICS 630-01 Annex U (ANNEX U - Uyghur_Personal_Names_FLTS (U).pdf), p. 2 (letter table); held source interscript-private-references/ics-630-01/ANNEX U - Uyghur_Personal_Names_FLTS (U).pdf. Extraction: annex text layer, every value cell cross-checked against the rendered page image. The printed table has three columns: Cyrillic letter, Uyghur Arabic-script spelling, IC Standard (Latin). The middle column is the Arabic-script equivalent and is not part of this Cyrl->Latn map; documented here, not transcribed as rows. Distinctive values verified visually: ә -> e (not a), в -> w (not v), х -> Latin x (not kh). The value cells for е and ә print the Latin letter e and х the Latin letter x; the text layer stores the lookalike Cyrillic glyphs (U+0435 / U+0445) — values transcribed from the printed image. General Notes: double digraphs as a single digraph (шш -> sh). Skipped printed rows: ъ, ь — not table rows; the General Notes state they are not transliterated (left out).
